rubric_floors_applied.fold_floor: >= 30 qualifying decisions per fold per arm (anchor, neighbour, control) - each of the 3 folds
rubric_floors_applied.control_floor: sham/control event count >= 50% of anchor count

no_pnl_statement: NO SCORED COMPUTATION OF ANY KIND was performed or emitted: no returns, no PF, no PnL, no cost-adjusted outcome, no signed price magnitude. The measurement is counts, dates and boolean flags only. Internally, sign bits (R == 0 exactly) and preregistered state booleans (rv5/rv20 bands, trend10 nonzero, PCA-concentration percentile flag, noise-floor comparison) were computed solely to define decision populations, per the A9 count-fidelity mandate; no magnitude appears in any output file. No scored outcome artifact of any past cycle was read; V5 artifacts consulted were confined to schedule semantics (run_contract.json decision_clock; the V5 D2 A9 feasibility artifact for the V5 A4-P1 fold-failure threshold cross-check that the V6 A4-P1 proposal explicitly requests).

measurement_basis.decision_calendar: per pair = staged 1day snapshot dates with weekday() < 5; provider weekend-stamped rows are not NY sessions and are excluded (measured exclusions per pair in evidence); bar completion instant = date 16:00 America/New_York, zoneinfo DST-correct
measurement_basis.clocks: research/control/forex_free_v6_run/p3_conditioning_clocks_v6.json: 246 clocks verified (GB 88 / CA 105 / AU 23 / NZ 30); all 105 CA rows carry available_for_daily_decision_date; exactly 3 CA boundary rows remap (2018-05-28->2018-05-29, 2018-05-29->2018-05-30, 2021-07-23->2021-07-26); all clock decision_dates and CA avail dates are weekdays; AU published clocks are 2019-10-30..2025-04-30 (gaps never published, fail-closed by construction)
measurement_basis.S0: 2018-04-04..2025-07-24 frozen; first funded decision day on every pair = 2018-09-03
measurement_basis.fold_freeze: A4 folds are frozen in the proposals (F1 2018-04-04..2020-12-31, F2 2021-01-01..2023-03-31, F3 2023-04-01..2025-07-24; assignment by event D0). A6 folds ('thirds of S0 by decision-day count', rubric delegates the freeze to A1/A9) are FROZEN HERE on the funded 7-pair common decision-day grid: F1 2018-09-03..2020-12-18, F2 2020-12-21..2023-04-05, F3 2023-04-06..2025-07-24; a full-S0-grid alternative freeze is measured as a sensitivity and does not change any verdict
measurement_basis.counts_reconciliation: A4-P1: events + skips == 246 per economy (GB 88 / CA 105 / AU 23 / NZ 30) enforced; A4-P2: pair-events + skips == 264 enforced; A6-P1: 246 enforced; A6-P2: decision-day scan over the funded grid

cross_proposal_findings.s0_head_data_gap: S0 starts 2018-04-04 but every staged 1day series starts 2018-09-03: a 152-calendar-day unfunded S0 head. 17 published clocks (GB 5, CA 10, NZ 1, AU 0; 2018-04-18..2018-08-17) fall inside it and are skipped pre-data in every clock-driven arm. FXFV6-A4-P1's warmup assertion ('this binds only against staging edge, not the S0 window') is contradicted by the staged bytes and is recorded as an asserted-not-evidenced bound (P-1 class). The gap alone does not break any floor except at FXFV6-A6-P1 (see verdict).
cross_proposal_findings.provider_weekday_gaps: inside the funded span: EURUSD 4 (2019-05-22, 2025-01-01, 2025-04-18, 2025-04-21), GBPUSD 4 (same dates), USDCHF 1 (2025-01-01), USDJPY 1 (2024-01-01), AUDUSD/NZDUSD/USDCAD 0. Exactly one clock is lost to a provider gap (GB 2019-05-22). No mid-S0 gap starves any fold.
cross_proposal_findings.data_alignment: PASS for all four proposals with a convention citation: the staged daily rows are date-keyed OHLC bars with no intraday timestamp; the mapping to the 16:00-NY decision close is the inherited frozen kernel convention (research/control/forex_free_v5_run/run_contract.json decision_clock 'daily 16:00-NY (DST)'; completed-daily-bar calendar = staged 1day weekday dates). This is the exact convention the proposals require ('per the inherited kernel decision_clock convention'). Weekend-stamped provider rows excluded per the same frozen convention (per-pair counts in evidence). Not byte-evident (a date-keyed bar cannot prove its cut time) - recorded as convention-evidenced, the strongest evidence class available in-repo.
cross_proposal_findings.runtime: the full four-proposal schedule reconstruction (7 pair calendars ~14.6k rows, 246 clocks, A6-P2 full PCA state series) runs in 0.47 s wall on this host; scoring phase (6 cells, cost-ladder recomputation) estimated in minutes - RUNTIME CLASS LIGHT for every proposal; nothing approaches 1h single-machine time

Two V5 decimation mechanisms are absent by construction here: V6 GB/AU DAY-precision clocks condition ON their decision_date (no next-day remap) and the V6 proposals carry no Friday session gate.

floor_failures.control: 35/38/47 passes the floor but cannot rescue the family (the floor binds on EVERY arm)

FXFV6-A6-P1.robustness_of_the_failure: under the alternative full-S0 thirds freeze (B1 2020-09-09, B2 2023-02-16) the anchor folds are 20/43/42 and the neighbour 19/30/29 - the failure persists under both freeze choices, so the verdict does not hinge on the A9 fold freeze
FXFV6-A6-P1.margin_to_proposal_own_gate: the proposal's own non_vacuity_floor is >= 15 per arm per fold; anchor 24/41/39 and neighbour 20/28/28 would pass THAT gate (min margin +5) - the RUBRIC floor of 30 governs eligibility and is what fails; margin-to-own-gate recorded per P-2 so the distinction is explicit
root_causes_measured: S0-head staged-data gap: 17 of 246 clocks unfunded (all in F1), plus 3 warmup skips (26-close requirement right after the data start) and 1 provider gap - F1 loses ~21 events before any state test

state scarcity: of the 223 event clocks that reach the state test, only ~109 land in the compression band (rv5 <= 0.9 x rv20); 38 land in the preregistered 0.9-1.1 dead zone (no event) and 78 in expansion - the dead zone plus band selectivity removes ~52% of the book
246-clock 4-pair book with AU contributing only 23 clocks (evidenced gaps pre-Sep-2019 and mid-2022 fail closed by construction) leaves thin per-third populations once the state gate is applied

identifiability.note: the +7d sham shifts the rv/trend windows enough that the compression flag agrees with the anchor twin on only 38.2% of comparable clocks - the sham schedule genuinely differs from the anchor schedule; no design failure on the control axis

FXFV6-A6-P1.turnover_cost_ceiling: 105 anchor round trips (315 bps aggregate at 1.0x, 630 bps at 2.0x) - moot for eligibility given the floor failure
FXFV6-A6-P1.warmup_coverage: first state-eligible clock ~2018-10-09 (26-close warmup after the data start); first compression-qualified decision 2018-12-19; the S0-head gap + warmup consume the head of F1
FXFV6-A6-P1.verdict_basis: rubric feasibility_floor: 'each of the 3 folds carries >= 30 qualifying decisions for EVERY arm (anchor, neighbour, control)' - FAILED by anchor F1 and by all neighbour folds; fail-closed, no rescue (weakening the dead zone, the bands or the folds after this measurement is forbidden)

FXFV6-A6-P2.count_unit: pair-leg entries (each leg = one round trip = one trade on the pooled per-trade identifying metric); entry DAYS: anchor 56/125/81, neighbour 124/204/245, placebo 31/126/74

state_series.note: the preregistered 75th-percentile rolling reference admits 32.7% of days rather than a stationary 25% - the concentration series trends upward across S0; does not affect any floor (recorded as a state-balance observation)

FXFV6-A6-P2.control_floor_50pct: PASS all folds (thinnest: F1 0.566, margin +0.066 above the 0.5 floor - thin, recorded per P-2; driven by the placebo's +100-day warmup shift eating into F1)

identifiability.collapse_check: the +100-day circularly-shifted state disagrees with the true state on 45.6% of comparable decision days and entry-day overlap is 53/262 - the placebo does NOT collapse to the anchor schedule

FXFV6-A6-P2.turnover_cost_ceiling: anchor 695 round trips; aggregate cost drag 2085 bps of exposure at tier 1.0x and 4170 bps at tier 2.0x; neighbour 1264 RTs (7584 bps at 2.0x). HIGHEST-TURNOVER BOOK OF THE WAVE. COST FLAG: HIGH - at ~230 anchor RTs/fold, the tier-2.0 primary gate requires mean gross per-trade edge > 6.0 bps round trip on 5-session holds; the aggregate drag makes the book cost-dominated unless that per-trade edge is comfortably positive (adjudicated in the scored phase; NOT computed here - no PnL). Frequency alone does not break the gate; the flag is structural.
FXFV6-A6-P2.warmup_coverage: 272-decision-day warmup on the funded grid ends 2019-09-19 - the proposal's 'approximately 2019-05' estimate is off by 4.5 months because of the S0-head staged-data gap; placebo first eligible 2020-02-06 (warmup + 100-day shift). F1 for the placebo starts at its shifted eligibility but still funds 81 leg decisions. No fold starved.
FXFV6-A6-P2.missing_day_rule: primary measurement runs the 7-pair intersection grid where every decision day has all 7 closes by construction (state_undefined_days = 0 measured); sensitivity on the universal funded weekday grid blocks 64 decision days (all in F3, from the 2025-01-01 / 2025-04-18 / 2025-04-21 provider-gap cluster; the 2019-05-22 gap precedes warmup end) - all folds remain far above floors under either implementation
FXFV6-A6-P2.fold_boundary_drops: anchor 0/0/0, neighbour 7/6/0, placebo 6/6/0 trades dropped per fold (exit fill crossing the fold boundary) - counted, not silently absorbed
FXFV6-A6-P2.runtime_class: LIGHT (7x7 eigendecomposition per decision day, ~1522 days: sub-second)
FXFV6-A6-P2.in_repo_information_only: PASS - staged prices only, no clocks consumed (verified: schedule contains no clock-derived date)
